name: Empowering Schedule Tribe/Schedule Caste Communities Using Information And Communication Technology Tools
benefit: - **Free Information Technology Related Trainings:** The scheme provides Information Technology related trainings to the Schedule Tribe and Schedule Caste beneficiaries free of cost.- **Training Content:** The trainings cover basic computer skills, various job oriented Information Technology training courses, and structural training programmes depending on the needs of the community.- **Implementi
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be of Goan Origin. - The applicant must belong to the Schedule Tribe/Schedule Caste Community. - The applicant must apply for courses offered under the Information Technology Knowledge Centers and available at the Information Technology training centers empanelled by M/s Info Tech Corporation of Goa Limited (ITG).
